title: Ragged Wide selected-column metadata admission through existing typed readers

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the finite canonical-stock/common-profile selected-column target; raw duplicate JSON rejection and universal layout/type compatibility are not claimed
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; all types/MV/projections and subsequent <=10% performance parity remain unclosed
claim.meaning: Curated index to actually executed root commands, current source state and raw captures; field presence, hashes and correlated model agreement alone are not behavioral proof.

risk.boundary: Persistent metadata/physical identity and typed consumer admission
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic feature commit; no push, dependency/guard change or history rewrite.

families: Generic Array(Tuple) already admitted by WideArrayTupleTypePlan
Map families already recognized by validate_map_serialization, including Map(Tuple)
laws: The selected physical declaration and existing admitted type predicates still own type identity.
Reuse the exact parsed-object common WITH_TYPES profile: version 1, propagated versions true, exactly String v1; valid sparse Default records and bounded known Tuple descendants.
A false proof follows the sole unchanged legacy family validator. Detected malformed JSON/types/counts fail as CorruptPartError, not another profile or codec.
Selected substreams must match an exact unique name set, then bind canonically; physical column block order stays unchanged.
Only actual UInt64 siblings are checked as plain UInt64, with canonical filename escaping.
Existing typed carriers, codecs, ragged schedules, frames/checksums, complete mark grids and logical materializer budgets remain.

schema: Array(Tuple(id UInt64, details Tuple(note Nullable(String), score UInt32)))
Map(String, Tuple(meta Tuple(note Nullable(String), id UInt64), score Nullable(Float64)))
features: Ordered duplicate Map keys and distinct values
fixture.profile: Wide LZ4/plain adaptive mrk2, common WITH_TYPES/String-v1 propagated versions, BASIC Map topology

non_guarantees: Raw duplicate JSON object-member rejection: Crystal JSON parser is last-wins; proof checks parsed objects.
Poco duplicate-member semantics: pinned CH parser identity was source-confirmed, vendored implementation unavailable; no equivalence claim.
Complete declared-type physical roster validation of every unselected non-UInt64 sibling.
All metadata versions, type products, Sparse/custom layouts and Map WITH_BUCKETS.
Context-owned Compact JSON/Dynamic, remaining aggregate/SAF/QBit/Geo layouts, compressed Compact marks and Compact writing.
Parent .proj authentication, broader projection/MV composition, native MV SQL/triggers/freshness and general keys/partitions.
Full repository suite, second native codec, exhaustive corruption handling, cross-version/endianness equivalence or authentication of all future payloads.
Exclusive native stdout grammar: oracle validates expected fixture tags/literals plus raw byte closure.
Total heap/RSS or caller snapshot limits; performance/global <=10% parity; concurrency/crash durability.
assumptions: Quiescent parts and trusted directory ancestry.
Separately pinned comparison source and executed runtime; no latest-source or source/runtime equivalence claim.

scopes: All 33 production diff lines and selected physical-roster binding
Existing admitted Map predicates/type gates and canonical escaping
Pinned CH BASIC Map metadata/stream law, outer rows_in_mark and actual Poco parser use
root_review.verdict: ROBUST within the finite target after claim narrowing
root_review.basis: Root source inspection, complete exact affected mode tests, stock literal consumer checks, physical coordinate falsifiers and actual-capture controls; not independent model agreement
root_review.correlated_luna_review: No admission/type/escaping bypass found; VULNERABLE only if raw duplicate JSON keys are called hard corruption. Root independently observed parser last-wins and explicitly excluded that claim.

production.algorithm: SHA256(JSON.generate(sorted array of {path,sha256})) using Ruby; rg --files src -g '*.cr' defines the roster

input_seals.scope: 545 production files plus 102 explicit specs and four harness/support files = 651 repository qualification inputs. Hash closure alone is not substantive compatibility proof.
